LUMBERJACK CAMP. OVERTIME EXPLAINED POORLY.

EST.1999STILL IN OVERTIME.

THE SCOREBOARD HAS A BACKSTORY

A little lodge.
A large distraction.

In our fictional 1999, a former lumber yard acquired a kitchen, several screens and a very loose understanding of the end of a game.

The first monster playoff went into overtime. Then double overtime. Then the officials were declared missing, and someone ordered more ribs. The scoreboard has displayed a draw ever since. Management calls this consistency and refuses to refund the decorative trophy.

Today the lodge serves smoky plates, cold drinks and cheerfully overdone Halloween camp. Our adult hosts wear pin-up lumberjack uniforms, work actual shifts and deserve ordinary respect. The jokes are in the branding. The staff are not part of a contest, a prize package or your supernatural investigation.

The beer garden offers pumpkin lanterns and a skeleton willing to hear your theory about the referee. The trophy crypt offers six entirely unofficial legends. The bar offers a zero-proof option for the person who intends to leave while regulation time is still a meaningful concept.

Bring your friends. Bring your appetite.
Leave the ghosting to the actual ghosts.

Is this a real restaurant?+

No. BooBies Lodge is a fictional Halloween parody property. Names, food, prices, facilities and policies are invented for creative exploration.

Who is this concept for?+

Adults 21+ seeking sports-bar food, game-night atmosphere, Halloween camp and cheeky lodge hospitality.

Can I book or order here?+

This creator workspace and its marketing pack do not accept bookings, orders, payments or mailing-list subscriptions.

What about allergies and access?+

Ingredients and V tags are working copy, not allergy assurances. Access and sensory details are fictional intentions and require real-world confirmation before use.

Do the outdoor spaces cost extra?+

No. The imagined house spaces and collection are free to explore; food and drinks have separate menu prices. You can skip any part of the itinerary. 21+ only in this fictional lodge concept. All hosts are adults. Costumes are camp; respectful behavior is required.

How does the visit planner work?+

Choose a concept date, an offered arrival, your party size and the spaces you want to explore. Save keeps the plan in this browser for this property. Downloads are fictional itineraries, not tickets or reservations.

What happens after dark?+
